comparison.objective: Even wire tips and twist a connector to a snug retained splice; candidate positions and locks proximity switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Threaded connector regrasping and wire capture versus partial screw release, linear sensor registration, and fastening without drift.
comparison.success_condition: Both wires retained, copper covered, connector snug and released; candidate requires two ≤6 mm over-center sensor states.
comparison.reason: Both contain fastening, but one tests threaded splice formation and the other feedback-guided mount calibration. Candidate torque and drift criteria are incomplete.
